title: The Oath Formula: Esküszöm / Fogadom, hogy...

sections.title: The Text of the Hungarian Citizenship Oath
sections.content: The text of the citizenship oath is set by law. This screen teaches the pattern, not the official wording: the oath is made with *esküszöm, hogy …*, and the pledge (fogadalom), which has no religious formula, with *fogadom, hogy …* + a clause.

items.english: I swear that I will keep the laws.

items.spanish: Fogadom, hogy tiszteletben tartom az Alaptörvényt.
items.english: I pledge that I will respect the Fundamental Law.

items.spanish: Esküszöm, hogy hű állampolgára leszek Magyarországnak.
items.english: I swear that I will be a loyal citizen of Hungary.
